# paperclip_users (Data Source)

Reads a list of Paperclip users by query or company scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_users" "directory" {
  company_id = data.paperclip_company.acme.id
  query      = "operator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (String) Optional company identifier to restrict listing to company members.
- `query` (String) Optional search query string (matches name or email).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `users` (List of Objects, see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users)) List of matching users.

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

### Read-Only

- `active_company_membership_count` (Number) Count of active company memberships.
- `email` (String) User email address.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `image` (String) User image URL.
- `is_instance_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an instance administrator.
- `name` (String) User display name.
